title: Toggleable Lanterns
description: This Mod changes all Lanterns to behave simelar to Candles, being able to be extinguished and lit.
body:
This Mod changes Lanters to have simelar mechanics to Candles. All lanterns can now be stopped from emmiting Light by extinguishing them by Right-Click with an empty hand. Lighting a Lantern requires a Flint And Steel or a Fire Charge.

Works Especially well with Shaderes or True Darkness mods.

I will upload the Source Code as soon as i a have a proper working Git Repo
